sqlMap.select: SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE DOC_NAME = 'OFFICE' AND KEY_2 = 'KRBEST0003' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'MHUB_CHG' AND TARGET = A.TARGET AND KEY_1 = A.KEY_1 AND KEY_9 = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'IF_B' AND CODE = A.TARGET AND FLAG = 'Y' AND A.KEY_10 > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - VALUE1/60/24,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
SELECT NVL(MAX(TYPE), ' ') AS COM_INFO_TYPE FROM ICOMCOD4 WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND TYPE IN ('H001', 'D001') AND FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT * FROM ICOMCOD4 A, ICOMPOHD B WHERE A.TYPE = #COM_INFO_TYPE# AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND CASE WHEN #COM_INFO_TYPE# = 'H001' THEN NVL(B.ADD_USER_ID, ' ') ELSE NVL(B.CHANGE_USER_DEPT, ' ') END = A.CODE2
AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = #PO_NO#

SELECT M.TYPE, M.COUNTRY, M.ADD_DATE, M.PO_NO, M.PO_SEQ, NVL(M.TEMP_COM_NAME,' ') AS COM_NAME, NVL((SELECT B.TEXT1 FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCOD2 B WHERE A.USER_ID = M.REQ_ID AND B.TYPE = 'C001' AND B.COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND B.CODE = A.DEPARTMENT), '') REQ_DEPT, M.BUYER_ITEM_NO, M.SELLER_ITEM_NO, M.DESCRIPTION, M.SPECIFICATION, M.UNIT_MEASURE, M.ITEM_QTY, M.AGENT_PRICE, CASE WHEN M.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' THEN (SELECT nvl(trim(substrb(text2,1,7)),'') FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = '001' AND COMPANY_CODE = M.WAREHOUSE_CODE ) ELSE CASE WHEN IS_NUMBER(REPLACE(F_SPLIT(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ',1),'-','')) = 0 THEN F_SPLIT(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ',1) ELSE '' END END AS ADD_ZIP, CASE WHEN M.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUBSTRB(TEXT2, 9 , LENGTHB(TEXT2) ), '') FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = '001' AND COMPANY_CODE = M.WAREHOUSE_CODE ) ELSE CASE WHEN IS_NUMBER(REPLACE(F_SPLIT(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ',1),'-','')) = 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION,LENGTH(F_SPLIT(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ',1))+1,300)) ELSE SUBSTR(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION,1,300) END END ADD_NAME, M.TEMP_REQ_NAME AS REQ_NAME, M.TEMP_REQ_TEL AS REQ_TEL, M.COL1, M.COL2, M.REMARK, M.REF_PR_NO, M.COM_GUBUN, M.BUYER, M.STATUS, M.UNIT_PRICE, NVL( M.TEMP_COM_IRS_NO,' ') AS COM_IRS_NO, NVL( M.TEMP_COM_CEO,' ') AS COM_CEO, NVL( M.TEMP_COM_ZIP,' ') AS COM_ZIP, NVL( M.TEMP_COM_ADD,' ') AS COM_ADD, NVL( M.TEMP_COM_INDUSTRY,' ') AS COM_INDUSTRY, NVL( M.TEMP_COM_BUSINESS,' ') AS COM_BUSINESS, M.PUR_ID, M.BUYER_CD, M.BUYER_NM, CASE WHEN M.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(M.IV_COLUMN, '^', 15) ELSE CASE WHEN M.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' AND M.WAREHOUSE_CODE = 'KRKORE0440' THEN CASE WHEN IS_NUMBER(REPLACE(F_SPLIT(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION ,' ',1),'-','')) = 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION, LENGTH(F_SPLIT(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION ,' ',1))+1,200)) ELSE SUBSTR(M.POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION ,1,200) END ELSE '' END END BUYER_ADD, M.BUYER_IRS, M.BUYER_SITE, M.BUYER_LOCATION, M.BUYER_REQ_NAME, M.BUYER_REQ_PHONE, M.BUYER_PUR_NAME, M.BUYER_PUR_PHONE, M.BUYER_ACC_NAME, M.BUYER_ACC_PHONE, M.LEGACY_PO_NO, M.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, M.BUYER_CIS_CODE, M.MAKER_NAME FROM ( SELECT 'D' AS TYPE, 'KP' AS COUNTRY, NVL(B.ADD_DATE, ' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(B.PO_NO, ' ') AS PO_NO, NVL(TO_CHAR(B.PO_SEQ,'FM000') ,' ') AS PO_SEQ, NVL(P.COM_NAME_LOC,' ') AS TEMP_COM_NAME, ' ' AS TEMP_REQ_DEPT, NVL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(B.SELLER_ITEM_NO, ' ') AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, NVL(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.DESCRIPTION, CHR(13),NULL),CHR(10),NULL),' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(REPLACE(REPLACE(B.SPECIFICATION, CHR(13),NULL),CHR(10),NULL),' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(B.UNIT_MEASURE, ' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN B.STATUS = 'D' THEN 0 ELSE NVL(B.ITEM_QTY, 0) END) AS ITEM_QTY, TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(NVL(B.AGENT_PRICE/KEP.F_GET_VATRATE_ITEM(B.BUYER, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO) , 0 ), '9999999999999.999999'))) AS AGENT_PRICE, CASE WHEN B.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' THEN TRIM(REPLACE(P.COM_NAME_LOC,'코리아이플랫폼(주)','')) WHEN B.BUYER IN ('KRKOLO0118', 'KRDONG0838', 'KRHANW0038','KRSAMS0123','KRSYSR0001') THEN NVL(F_SPLIT(TRIM(C.REQ_USER_INFO),'/',1), NVL(D.CHANGE_USER_NAME,' ')) ELSE NVL(D.CHANGE_USER_NAME, ' ') END AS TEMP_REQ_NAME, CASE WHEN B.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' THEN P.TEL_NO WHEN B.BUYER IN ('KRKOLO0118', 'KRDONG0838', 'KRHANW0038','KRSAMS0123','KRSYSR0001') THEN NVL(F_SPLIT(TRIM(C.REQ_USER_INFO),'/',3), NVL(D.CHANGE_USER_TEL,' ')) WHEN SLG.COM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND L.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND D.CHANGE_USER_ID != 'FTP' THEN NVL(L.MOBILE_PHONE, NVL(D.CHANGE_USER_TEL, ' ')) ELSE NVL(D.CHANGE_USER_TEL, ' ') END AS TEMP_REQ_TEL, '1' AS COL1, '1' AS COL2, SUBSTRB(NVL(REPLACE(REPLACE(DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',F.COM_NAME_LOC||'.','')||DECODE(TRIM(A.PO_REMARK||' '||REPLACE(B.PO_REMARK,'^||^',' ')),NULL,NULL,TRIM(A.PO_REMARK||' '||REPLACE(B.PO_REMARK,'^||^',' '))),CHR(13),NULL),CHR(10),NULL),' '),1,100) AS REMARK, SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_SINGLE_BYTE(DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'X',B.PR_NO,B.REF_PR_NO)),' '),1,49) AS REF_PR_NO, 'KEP' AS COM_GUBUN, NVL(B.BUYER, ' ') AS BUYER, NVL(B.STATUS, ' ') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(NVL(B.UNIT_PRICE, 0)) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(P.IRS_NO,' ') AS TEMP_COM_IRS_NO, NVL(P.CEO_NAME_LOC,' ') AS TEMP_COM_CEO, NVL(P.ZIP_CODE,' ') AS TEMP_COM_ZIP, NVL(P.ADDRESS_LOC,' ') AS TEMP_COM_ADD, NVL(P.INDUSTRY_TYPE,' ') AS TEMP_COM_INDUSTRY, NVL(P.BUSINESS_ITEMS,' ') AS TEMP_COM_BUSINESS, NVL(A.ADD_USER_ID, ' ') AS PUR_ID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN 'C100' ELSE '' END AS BUYER_CD, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN '삼성전자(주)' ELSE CASE WHEN B.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' AND B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = 'KRKORE0440' THEN (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = B.BUYER) ELSE '' END END AS BUYER_NM, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN REPLACE(F.IRS_NO,'-','') ELSE '' END AS BUYER_IRS, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 13) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_SITE, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 16) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_LOCATION, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 5) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_REQ_NAME, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 6) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_REQ_PHONE, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 7) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_PUR_NAME, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 8) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_PUR_PHONE, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 10) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_ACC_NAME, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 11) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_ACC_PHONE, NVL(B.LEGACY_PO_NO, '') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, '') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'SSEC') THEN F_SPLIT(C.IV_COLUMN, '^', 2) ELSE '' END AS BUYER_CIS_CODE, NVL(B.MAKER_NAME, ' ') AS MAKER_NAME, (SELECT NVL(MAX(TYPE), ' ') FROM ICOMCOD4 WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND TYPE IN ('H001', 'D001') AND FLAG = 'Y') AS COM_INFO_TYPE, NVL(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, CHR(13),NULL),CHR(10),NULL),' ') AS POHD_DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION ,' ') AS PODT_DELY_TO_LOCATION, B.WAREHOUSE_CODE, B.PROCESS_TYPE, C.IV_COLUMN, C.REQ_USER_ID AS REQ_ID, NVL(A.CHANGE_USER_DEPT, ' ') AS PUR_DEPT_CODE FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPRDT C, ICOMPRHD D, ICOMCMPY F, BNTSLGIMP SLG, ICOMLUSR L, ICOMCMPY P WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PR_NO = B.PR_NO AND C.PR_SEQ = B.PR_SEQ AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND D.BUYER = C.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = C.PR_NO AND D.STATUS != 'D' AND F.COM_CODE = B.BUYER AND F.STATUS != 'D' AND D.CHANGE_USER_ID = L.USER_ID(+) AND 'P16-0000003' = SLG.SLG_ID(+) AND B.BUYER = SLG.COM_CODE(+)
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') >= SLG.OPEN_DATE(+) AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= SLG.CLOSE_DATE(+)
AND P.COM_CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE, '2', B.WAREHOUSE_CODE, B.BUYER) AND P.STATUS != 'D' ) M ORDER BY M.BUYER, M.PO_NO, M.PO_SEQ

sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'OFFICE' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_1 = #PO_NO# AND KEY_2 = 'KRBEST0003'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMPOHD SET SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND STATUS != 'D'
sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND STATUS != 'D'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO ICOMPORS ( BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ , DS_SEQ, STATUS, SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME, SELLER, BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION , UNIT_MEASURE, CD_DATE, CD_QTY , DS_DATE, PO_CHECK_CODE, ACCOUNT_TYPE , ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_ID, COMPLETE_MARK , ADMIN_FLAG1, ADMIN_FLAG2, DS_REMARK , DE_REMARK, SEND_FLAG, AGENCY_USER_ID , BUYER_DS_DATE ) SELECT X.BUYER , X.PO_NO , X.PO_SEQ , TO_CHAR(NVL(Y.DS_SEQ,1),'FM000000') AS DS_SEQ , 'C' AS STATUS , NULL AS SEND_DATE , NULL AS SEND_TIME , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME , NULL AS CONFIRM_DATE , NULL AS CONFIRM_TIME , X.SELLER , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO , X.SELLER_ITEM_NO , X.DESCRIPTION , X.SPECIFICATION , X.UNIT_MEASURE , DECODE(X.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD'),X.RD_DATE) AS CD_DATE , X.ITEM_QTY AS CD_QTY , DECODE(X.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(X.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD'),X.RD_DATE) AS DS_DATE , NULL AS PO_CHECK_CODE , ACCOUNT_TYPE , 'FTP' AS ADD_USER_ID , NULL AS CHANGE_USER_ID , 'N' AS COMPLETE_MARK , 'N' AS ADMIN_FLAG1 , 'N' AS ADMIN_FLAG2 , NULL AS DS_REMARK , NULL AS DE_REMARK , 'N' AS SEND_FLAG , NULL AS AGENCY_USER_ID , DECODE(X.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',X.RD_DATE, '2',F_GET_WORKINGDAY(X.RD_DATE,2),NULL) AS BUYER_DS_DATE FROM ICOMPODT X, (SELECT BUYER,PO_NO,PO_SEQ,TO_NUMBER(MAX(DS_SEQ))+1 AS DS_SEQ FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# GROUP BY BUYER,PO_NO,PO_SEQ) Y WHERE X.BUYER = #BUYER# AND X.PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND X.STATUS != 'D' AND X.BUYER = Y.BUYER(+) AND X.PO_NO = Y.PO_NO(+) AND X.PO_SEQ = Y.PO_SEQ(+) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMPORS WHERE STATUS != 'D' AND BUYER = X.BUYER AND PO_NO = X.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ= X.PO_SEQ)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMPODT SET DS_DATE = DECODE(PROCESS_TYPE,'2',TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD'),RD_DATE) , DS_FLAG = 'Y' , DO_QTY = ITEM_QTY , SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND STATUS != 'D'

UPDATE ICOMPOHD SET CONFIRM_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CONFIRM_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') , CONFIRM_USER_ID = 'FTP' , SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PO_NO = #PO_NO# AND STATUS != 'D'
